name: The Casagrandes
description: The Casagrandes tells the story of Ronnie Anne, an independent, adventurous, 11-year-old who explores city life with her big, loving, multi-generational Mexican-American family.

videos.title: Going Overboard
videos.overview: When Ronnie Anne finds out her Tio Carlos was a famous skateboarder, she begs him to teach her some new moves.

videos.title: Walk Don't Run
videos.overview: In order to buy a new skateboard, Ronnie Anne and Sid start a dog-walking business that quickly gets out of hand.

videos.title: The Two of Clubs
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and Sid look for an after-school activity to do together, but nothing seems to be right for them both.

videos.title: Vacation Daze
videos.overview: When Maria finally gets a day off, Ronnie Anne has to compete with her family for some much-needed quality time.

videos.title: New Haunts
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne forgoes a family Halloween tradition for a “cool” party but learns “cool” doesn’t always mean “fun.”

videos.title: Croaked
videos.overview: Trying to help Adelaide to get over the death of her frog, Ronnie Anne and Sid teach her about Day of the Dead.

videos.title: Snack Pact
videos.overview: The family discovers an amazing tamale cart and tries to keep it a secret from Abuela.

videos.title: The Horror-Scope
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne doesn't believe in an astrological prediction that "love will find her," until it seems to come true. Guest Starring: George Lopez

videos.title: Arr in the Family
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne is determined to help CJ get onstage at a Pirate Dinner Show.

videos.title: Finders Weepers
videos.overview: Ronnie and Sid have to decide whether they "borrow" money from a lost coin purse they found in the mercado.

videos.title: Stress Test
videos.overview: The family tries to help Bobby get over his test taking anxieties.

videos.title: How to Train Your Carl
videos.overview: Carl gets lost in the city zoo after sneaking away from his family, in search of Keyon, the Komodo dragon.

videos.title: Operation Dad
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne tries to convince her Dad to move to the city while he is visiting. With the help of Sid, she devises a plan that seems too good to fail.

videos.title: Flee Market
videos.overview: Bobby struggles to give up control of the mercado during his pizza-versary date with Lori.

videos.title: Copy Can't
videos.overview: When Ronnie Anne notices that she’s the only person Carlitos won’t copy, she’s determined to change it!

videos.title: Away Game
videos.overview: Abuela worries that Ronnie Anne and Bobby will want to live at their Dad’s new apartment permanently.

videos.title: Monster Cash
videos.overview: Carl hosts a haunted tour based on Abuela’s tale of “El Cucuy,” and learns that this story may not be fiction.

videos.title: Trend Game
videos.overview: When Ronnie Anne realizes that she’s not up to date on all of the latest trends, she seeks help from Carlota.

videos.title: This Bird Has Flown
videos.overview: Bobby struggles to find Sergio after wishing he would fly away and never come back.

videos.title: V.I.Peeved
videos.overview: Carlota worries that her family will embarrass her after her vlog is discovered by a famous musician. Guest Star: Ally Brooke

videos.title: Señor Class
videos.overview: Hector becomes Ronnie Anne and Carl’s newest classmate after deciding to finish his schooling.

videos.title: Fast Feud
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and Sid try to take down the obnoxious burger restaurant that opened up across the street.

videos.title: Never Friending Story
videos.overview: After picking Par as his new best friend, Bobby realizes he may be in over his head.

videos.title: Grandparent Trap
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne thinks her grandparent’s marriage is in trouble after watching a relationship talk show. Guest Star: Cristela Alonzo

videos.title: Miss Step
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne learns the art of baile folklorico – and that her Tia Frida is one intense instructor!

videos.title: Slink or Swim
videos.overview: When Bobby finds out Carl can’t swim, he offers to show him the ways of the waves!

videos.title: The Big Chill
videos.overview: After begging Abuelo for some A/C, the cousins decide to earn some cash at the neighborhood fair.

videos.title: Karma Chameleon
videos.overview: The Changs go on vacation and leave Ronnie Anne and her cousins to watch after Cam, the chameleon snake.

videos.title: Team Effort
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and her skate buddies work together to show their coach that they have what it takes to make a team.

videos.title: Guess Who's Shopping for Dinner?
videos.overview: Abuela teaches Ronnie Anne that getting ingredients for dinner is no small task.

videos.title: New Roomie
videos.overview: When Vito’s apartment floods, the kids try to find an apartment that suits him best.

videos.title: Mexican Makeover
videos.overview: When Mama Lupe comes to visit, Abuela tries to get her family at the top of their cultural game. Guest Star: Angelica Aragon as Mama Lupe

videos.title: Uptown Funk
videos.overview: Adelaide and Carl have an adventure on Mr. Chang’s route, but can they work together to save the day?

videos.title: Bo Bo Business
videos.overview: After a disagreement with Abuelo, Bobby goes to work for Mr. Hong to try out his new business ideas.

videos.title: Blunder Party
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and Sid are pumped up for their sleepover, but Carl and Adelaide might ruin the day.

videos.title: Cursed!
videos.overview: Celebrity psychic Ernesto Estrella deems Great Lakes City to be bad luck and Abuela believes him.

videos.title: What's Love Gato Do With It?
videos.overview: After a magician hypnotizes Bobby into thinking he's a cat, the family needs to snap him out of it.

videos.title: Dial 'M' for Mustard
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and her friends uncover a town mystery: what happened to Bruno's hot dog cart?

videos.title: The Kid Plays in the Picture
videos.overview: Because of his love of toys, Carl becomes a professional toy reviewer.

videos.title: Achy Breaky Art
videos.overview: Frida's artworks receive bad reviews, so the children try to cheer her up.

videos.title: Fails from the Crypt
videos.overview: The kids try to break a local record for staying in the cemetery overnight.

videos.title: Bad Cluck
videos.overview: A haunted chicken is pestering the Casagrandes.

videos.title: Guilt Trip
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and her primos try to win a trip around the world for Maria.

videos.title: Short Cut
videos.overview: When Carlota fails at hair cutting, she trains with CJ, the master barber.

videos.title: No Egrets
videos.overview: Sergio is in for a treat when a group of baby birds thinks he's their mama.

videos.title: Meal Ticket
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and Sid help Casey run his family food truck at a Yoon Kwan concert.

videos.title: Fool's Gold
videos.overview: When they find a treasure map, the Casagrandes go on a wild search for Pancho Villa's gold.

videos.title: Flight Plan
videos.overview: Frida and Carlos go on a fancy plane ride, but Carl and CJ try to sneak on for an adventure of their own.

videos.title: A Very Casagrande Christmas
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne is excited for the perfect Christmas, but visits from the neighbors put her dream Nochebuena on hold.

videos.title: An Udder Mess
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne has to choose between besties Sid and Lincoln for the day.

videos.title: Teacher's Fret
videos.overview: When Ronnie Anne finds out her dad is dating her teacher, she teams with Sid to break them up ASAP!

videos.title: I, Breakfast Bot!
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and her cousins hatch a plan to have Sid’s Breakfast Bot do their chores – ALL of them!

videos.title: Dynamic Do-Over
videos.overview: When Carl’s dreams are crushed after meeting El Falcon, Bobby decides to take on the role himself!

videos.title: Home Improvement
videos.overview: Laird is nervous to host movie night at his house, so Ronnie Anne helps him pretend Arturo’s pad is his own!

videos.title: Undivided Attention
videos.overview: Carlota can’t seem to pay attention to anything but her phone, so Carlos sets her up – with a math tutor!

videos.title: Karate Chops
videos.overview: Used to being top dog, Carl can't handle when Adelaide joins his karate class and becomes the star student.

videos.title: Taco the Town
videos.overview: Hector starts selling Rosa's delicious tacos but gets overwhelmed when they're more popular than the mercado.

videos.title: Saving Face
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and Sid are determined to find out whether the new building tenant is their favorite wrestler La Tormenta.

videos.title: Matters of the Kart
videos.overview: After an old man wins Carl's dream go-kart, Carl wants to prove that he's worthy of the prize himself.

videos.title: Chancia Force
videos.overview: Carlitos goes on a wild adventure to get his favorite stuffed animal from an arcade.

videos.title: Fluff Love
videos.overview: Carl takes Rosa's chancla, calling the Chancla Force into action.

videos.title: Battle of the Grandpas
videos.overview: When Frida's fun dad comes to visit, Hector tries to win back his grandchildren's attention.

videos.title: Prankaversary
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and Lincoln are set for a big day of pranks, and newbie Sid wants to join in on the fun too.

videos.title: Zoo-mergency!
videos.overview: After a zoo fundraiser goes wrong, Sid must save the day with her family.

videos.title: Just Be Coo
videos.overview: When Sancho gets himself into trouble in the city, Sergio helps him become a model pet.

videos.title: Tee'd Off
videos.overview: Worried that Lori may have a new crush, Bobby visits her in college and tries to impress her with his golf skills.

videos.title: Lalo Land
videos.overview: The Casagrandes prepare Lalo for his big audition to be Phoebe Powers' new canine sidekick.

videos.title: Maybe-Sitter
videos.overview: With the adults out for the night, Bobby and Carlota take turns watching the kids – and going to a party!

videos.title: Do the Fruit Shake
videos.overview: Carl's new song samples a singing group, but he needs their okay before it can play on the radio.

videos.title: Throwing Pains
videos.overview: During a snow day, Ronnie Anne and her skater pals must battle for the gym space by playing dodgeball.

videos.title: Spin Off
videos.overview: After seeing CJ's awesome spin moves, Par helps CJ enter and train for a sign spinning competition.

videos.title: Tooth or Consequences
videos.overview: When Adelaide loses a tooth, Carl and Bobby teach her about El Raton, the Latin American "tooth fairy."

videos.title: Operation Popstar
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and Sid try to get Yoon Kwan's autograph and Carlota helps Alisa prepare for the Great Lakes City Music Festival.

videos.title: Strife Coach
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and her friends help get Mrs. Kernicky hired as the new PE coach, but her classes are no joke.

videos.title: Gossipy Girl
videos.overview: When a Sid secret is leaked at school, Ronnie Anne and Sid wonder if they can continue being best buds.

videos.title: Bend It Like Abuelo
videos.overview: Hector finally joins his dream soccer team as their good luck charm.

videos.title: Bunstoppable
videos.overview: While preparing bao for the Chinese Cultural Fair, Sid and Adelaide face off against time-hopping bandits.

videos.title: Squawk in the Name of Love
videos.overview: Sergio enlists Adelaide's help to become a gentleman in order to win Priscilla back.

videos.title: Date with Destiny
videos.overview: Rosa hears an Ernesto Estrella prediction that Maria and Arturo could get back together.

videos.title: Curse of the Candy Goblin
videos.overview: When Carl takes trick or treating too far, he must return his candy to the neighborhood goblin.

videos.title: Skaters Gonna Hate
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and her pals enlist Carlos X as their coach in a skate-off against Tony Hawk!

videos.title: Born to Be Mild
videos.overview: Tired of the bullies at school, Alexis learns the tough guy ropes from Carl.

videos.title: The Bros in the Band
videos.overview: Bobby's dream of playing in a band might finally come true, but can he hang with Par's punk pals?

videos.title: For the Record
videos.overview: Worried he's not keeping up with his cool friends, Sameer tries to break a record for some street cred.

videos.title: 15 Candles
videos.overview: Already planning Ronnie Anne's quinceañera, Rosa decides to train Ronnie Anne - for the next 3 years!

videos.title: Rook, Line, & Sinker
videos.overview: Carlos gets Carl into chess to keep him out of trouble, but Carl takes his rule of the kingdom literally!

videos.title: The Golden Curse
videos.overview: The Casagrandes celebrate Paco's wedding, but they need to find las arras that Sergio lost!

videos.title: Let's Get Ready to Rumba
videos.overview: When Hector declines Rosa's offer to join her dance class, he quickly gets jealous of her talented instructor!

videos.title: Perro Malo
videos.overview: Our sweet Lalo gets switched with mischievous perrito Malo for the day and the Casagrandes need to get their pup back.

videos.title: Don't Zoo That
videos.overview: Adelaide and Carl go head to head to win Junior Zookeeper badges, but their competitiveness might ruin both of their chances.

videos.title: Maxed Out
videos.overview: Hector finds out that Vito has a huge tab at the mercado and Vito offers to pay him back -- no matter what.

videos.title: Skatey Cat
videos.overview: Nervous to jump back on her board after a bad wipeout, will Ronnie Anne ever skate again?

videos.title: Weather Beaten
videos.overview: A powerful artifact is coming to the Great Lakes City museum and it brings along a storm for the Casagrandes!

videos.title: Race Against the Machine
videos.overview: When Mr. Chang's job might go to a faster train conductor, he has to prove that he can be just as fast as a robot!

videos.title: My Fair Cat Lady
videos.overview: Adelaide wants to help the city cats clean up their acts for adoption, but can she help these grumpy gatos?

videos.title: Survival of the Unfittest
videos.overview: When Arturo realizes Bobby doesn't have survival skills, he decides bring Bobby to the woods for training!

videos.title: Nixed Signals
videos.overview: Frida asks Carlota to spend a spa day with her to enjoy quality time, but can they both stay off their phones?

videos.title: Ay Fidelity
videos.overview: When Bobby and Par are left in charge of Ziggy’s shop, they must resist jamming with the shop’s musical treasures.

videos.title: Cut the Chisme
videos.overview: The family tries to stop their notorious chismoso Hector from gossiping all over town but can he stay quiet?

videos.title: Sidekickin’ Chicken
videos.overview: After hearing about a contest to find El Falcon's next sidekick, Carl becomes El Pollito and tries to win!

videos.title: Silent Fight
videos.overview: Once Carlitos falls asleep, Carl and CJ must conduct all their playing - and fighting - in absolute silence!

videos.title: Kick Some Bot
videos.overview: Sid faces off against Lisa Loud in the Great Lakes City robotics competition!

videos.title: Salvador Doggy
videos.overview: When faced with a deadline and no inspiration, Frida ties to uses Lalo's paintings as her own!

videos.title: The Wurst Job
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne lands the internship of a lifetime with Bruno, but will she be able to hang?

videos.title: The Sound of Meddle
videos.overview: Dreaming of DJing at the Gatos halftime show, Carl goes undercover with Alexis and the school band!

videos.title: Alpaca Lies
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and Bobby have to deal with an old friend of Arturo's—Beto the Alpaca, but Beto has it out for the kids.

videos.title: Rocket Plan
videos.overview: Abuelo helps CJ build a rocket, but when things aren't going well, Abuelo tells a little fib to preserve CJ's feelings.

videos.title: Phantom Freakout
videos.overview: Ronnie Anne and the gang are going to be in 12IM's new music video, but things go awry when a ghost wreaks havoc in the concert hall. The kids and 12IM have to find out how to appease the ghost, and quick!

videos.title: The Oddfather
videos.overview: Carlos has to choose Carlitos' padrino in time for his Christening, but will he make the right call?

videos.title: Long Shot
videos.overview: Carlota needs a PE credit to graduate, so she and Ronnie Anne set out to find the right sport for her.

videos.title: Flock This Way
videos.overview: Rosa’s family activity of birdwatching in the woods goes sour when Sergio gets mistaken for a rare species.

videos.title: Movers and Fakers
videos.overview: Tired of not having a space of his own, Bobby secretly moves into a vacant apartment unit in the building.
